chapter: Wynn: New York and Chicago bands
title: Great musicians as fine people
summary: They agree the great musicians were fine fellows while lesser ones caused trouble.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah, he was a nice fellow.
I found that all your great musicians were really wonderful fellows.
I think so, too. It was funny.
And the little fellows that you don't, the class amount to too much.
Those are the ones that try to make life miserable and hard for everybody. One of the unfortunate situations of life.
